questions.question: Simplify using BODMAS: 3 + 4 × 2
questions.explanation: Multiplication before addition: 4 × 2 = 8, then 3 + 8 = 11

questions.question: Simplify using BODMAS: (2 + 3) × 4
questions.explanation: Brackets first: 2 + 3 = 5, then 5 × 4 = 20

questions.question: Simplify using BODMAS: 10 - 2 × 3
questions.explanation: Multiplication before subtraction: 2 × 3 = 6, then 10 - 6 = 4

questions.question: Simplify using BODMAS: 20 ÷ 4 + 3
questions.explanation: Division before addition: 20 ÷ 4 = 5, then 5 + 3 = 8

options: She go to school every day
She goes to school every day
She going to school every day
She gone to school every day

questions.question: What tense is the sentence 'I am eating'?
questions.explanation: 'am eating' describes an action happening now - present continuous tense

questions.question: What tense is the sentence 'I ate rice'?
questions.explanation: 'ate' is the past form of 'eat' - simple past tense

questions.question: What tense is the sentence 'I will go home'?
questions.explanation: 'will go' describes an action yet to happen - simple future tense

questions.question: What tense is the sentence 'I have finished my homework'?
questions.explanation: 'have finished' links a past action to the present result - present perfect tense

questions.question: What is a synonym for 'happy'?
questions.explanation: 'Joyful' has the same meaning as 'happy'

questions.question: What is an antonym for 'hot'?
questions.explanation: 'Cold' is the opposite of 'hot'

questions.question: What is a synonym for 'big'?
questions.explanation: 'Large' has the same meaning as 'big'

questions.question: What is an antonym for 'fast'?
questions.explanation: 'Slow' is the opposite of 'fast'

questions.question: What is the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria are the powerhouse of the cell

questions.question: Which part of the cell controls its activities?
questions.explanation: The nucleus controls the cell's activities and holds its genetic material

questions.question: What structure gives a plant cell its rigid shape?
questions.explanation: The cell wall is a rigid layer that supports and shapes a plant cell

questions.question: Which cell structure is the site of protein synthesis?
questions.explanation: Ribosomes are where proteins are made in a cell

questions.question: What is the largest organ in the human body?
questions.explanation: The skin is the largest organ in the human body

questions.question: Which organ pumps blood around the body?
questions.explanation: The heart pumps blood around the body

questions.question: Which organ filters waste from the blood?
questions.explanation: The kidneys filter waste products out of the blood

questions.question: Which organs are used for breathing?
questions.explanation: The lungs take in oxygen and remove carbon dioxide during breathing

questions.question: Which part of a plant carries out photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: The leaf contains chlorophyll, which traps sunlight for photosynthesis

questions.question: Which gas do plants absorb for photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air to use in photosynthesis

questions.question: Which part of a plant absorbs water from the soil?
questions.explanation: The roots absorb water and minerals from the soil

questions.question: Which gas do plants release during photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis releases oxygen as a byproduct

questions.question: Which food class mainly provides the body with energy?
questions.explanation: Carbohydrates are the body's main energy source

questions.question: Which food class is needed for growth and repair of body tissue?
questions.explanation: Proteins build and repair body tissues

questions.question: Which vitamin does the body produce from sunlight?
questions.explanation: The skin produces vitamin D when exposed to sunlight

questions.question: A diet containing all necessary food classes in the right amounts is called what?
questions.explanation: A balanced diet supplies all food classes (carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, water) in the right proportions

questions.explanation: A verb is an action word

questions.question: What is an adjective?
questions.explanation: An adjective describes a noun

questions.question: In 'She ran quickly', what part of speech is 'quickly'?
questions.explanation: 'Quickly' describes how she ran, so it is an adverb

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: 'Boys' is plural, so it takes the plural verb 'were'

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: She go to school every day
She goes to school every day
She going to school every day
She gone to school every day
questions.correct: She goes to school every day
questions.explanation: 'She' is third-person singular, so the verb takes an -s: 'goes'

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: 'They' is plural, so it takes the plural verb 'are'

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: 'He' is third-person singular, so it takes 'is'

questions.question: What tense is the sentence 'I am eating'?
questions.explanation: 'am eating' describes an action happening now - present continuous tense

questions.question: What tense is the sentence 'I ate rice'?
questions.explanation: 'ate' is the past form of 'eat' - simple past tense

questions.question: What tense is the sentence 'I will go home'?
questions.explanation: 'will go' describes an action yet to happen - simple future tense

questions.question: What tense is the sentence 'I have finished my homework'?
questions.explanation: 'have finished' links a past action to the present result - present perfect tense

questions.question: What is a synonym for 'happy'?
questions.explanation: 'Joyful' has the same meaning as 'happy'

questions.question: What is an antonym for 'hot'?
questions.explanation: 'Cold' is the opposite of 'hot'

questions.question: What is a synonym for 'big'?
questions.explanation: 'Large' has the same meaning as 'big'

questions.question: What is an antonym for 'fast'?
questions.explanation: 'Slow' is the opposite of 'fast'

questions.question: What is the powerhouse of the cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria are the powerhouse of the cell

questions.question: Which part of the cell controls its activities?
questions.explanation: The nucleus controls the cell's activities and holds its genetic material

questions.question: What structure gives a plant cell its rigid shape?
questions.explanation: The cell wall is a rigid layer that supports and shapes a plant cell

questions.question: Which cell structure is the site of protein synthesis?
questions.explanation: Ribosomes are where proteins are made in a cell

questions.question: What is the largest organ in the human body?
questions.explanation: The skin is the largest organ in the human body

questions.question: Which organ pumps blood around the body?
questions.explanation: The heart pumps blood around the body

questions.question: Which organ filters waste from the blood?
questions.explanation: The kidneys filter waste products out of the blood

questions.question: Which organs are used for breathing?
questions.explanation: The lungs take in oxygen and remove carbon dioxide during breathing

questions.question: Which part of a plant carries out photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: The leaf contains chlorophyll, which traps sunlight for photosynthesis

questions.question: Which gas do plants absorb for photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air to use in photosynthesis

questions.question: Which part of a plant absorbs water from the soil?
questions.explanation: The roots absorb water and minerals from the soil

questions.question: Which gas do plants release during photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis releases oxygen as a byproduct

questions.question: Which food class mainly provides the body with energy?
questions.explanation: Carbohydrates are the body's main energy source

questions.question: Which food class is needed for growth and repair of body tissue?
questions.explanation: Proteins build and repair body tissues

questions.question: Which vitamin does the body produce from sunlight?
questions.explanation: The skin produces vitamin D when exposed to sunlight

questions.question: A diet containing all necessary food classes in the right amounts is called what?
questions.explanation: A balanced diet supplies all food classes (carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals, water) in the right proportions
